intent: Move the standalone billsplit Flutter app (receipt splitting with e-paragon import) out of ~/Downloads and into the testsAndMisc monorepo as billsplit/, with its CI actually running and a shared-family launcher icon replacing the stock Flutter one.
scope: billsplit/ — whole Flutter app tree, copied in and re-rooted
.gitignore — ! overrides so the blanket *.png / *.ico / *.manifest rules stop swallowing platform icon assets
.binary-allowlist — new file; the documented in-repo exception for build-input binaries
.github/workflows/billsplit-ci.yml — relocated from billsplit/.github/, which GitHub never reads when nested
python_pkg/app_icons/{glyphs,apps}.py — new receipt-split glyph and billsplit registry entry
python_pkg/billsplit_coverage/ — new package; the app's coverage gate, relocated out of billsplit/tool/
.pre-commit-config.yaml — codespell ignore-words-list gains the Polish word `dokument`
meta/scripts/pytest_changed_packages.py and run_prettier_capped.sh — hook memory ceilings lowered to fit a 2G budget
Non-goal: no change to billsplit's own Dart source, tests, or behaviour
Non-goal: no Linux desktop entry / hicolor icon set — the app is phone-first
changes: Copied the tree and dropped its .git, .idea and .flutter-plugins-dependencies; billsplit's own nested .gitignore is kept and still correctly hides generated registrants, gradlew, ephemeral/ and coverage/.

Added a trailing billsplit block of ! overrides to .gitignore. It sits at the end of the file deliberately: gitignore is last-match-wins, and *.manifest lives in the PyInstaller section further down than the image block.

Created .binary-allowlist (it did not exist) with glob — not literal — patterns, so the entries survive icon regeneration. Departed from the memory's ../testsAndMisc_binaries/ + symlink scheme: those sibling directories no longer exist, and a symlinked PNG breaks flutter build on a fresh clone.
Relocated the CI workflow to the repository root with defaults.run.working-directory: billsplit and an on.push.paths filter, so it neither stays inert nor fires on unrelated Python/Bash commits.

Added a receipt-split glyph to the shared generator and registered billsplit, rather than hand-rolling a per-repo icon. The glyph is a filled silhouette because a stroked receipt cannot carry a fine torn edge at the family's 72px stroke; the split is a perforation cut with fill-rule=evenodd so the holes stay transparent on the icon_foreground and icon_monochrome layers.

Rewrote the coverage gate into typed functions writing to sys.stdout/sys.stderr. It had entered repo-wide ruff/mypy/pylint for the first time, and ruff --fix had stripped every print() call, leaving the failure branch as a bare `pass` that exited 1 while reporting nothing.

Moved that gate from billsplit/tool/coverage_check.py to python_pkg/billsplit_coverage/, so the check-python-location rule holds with no new exception and billsplit/ contains only Dart. It gained a --project flag and a 19-test suite at 100% branch coverage, which the python_pkg gate now requires of it; the CI step runs it from the repository root via `python3 -m python_pkg.billsplit_coverage`.

Added the Polish word `dokument` to codespell's ignore-words-list, alongside the Polish entries already there (sie, numer, adres, parametr, tekst, serwer, grup, blok, metod). It is a field name in the e-paragon schema, so correcting it to `document` would break the parser that matches on it.

Lowered the hook memory ceilings to fit a 2G budget: pytest_changed_packages.py from 4G to 2G and run_prettier_capped.sh from 1G to 512M (Node heap 768M to 384M). These were not merely generous, they were actively harmful — a nested systemd scope requesting more than its parent's budget gets OOM-killed from the inside, so the 4G request made the suite fail rather than throttle whenever a caller imposed a tighter cap. Both new values are set from measurement, not guesswork.
Added test_no_glyph_paints_the_background_colour, codifying the invariant that a glyph hole must be an evenodd cut rather than a charcoal-painted shape.

verification.command: cd billsplit && flutter test --coverage && python3 -m python_pkg.billsplit_coverage
verification.evidence: 59 tests passed from the new location; '100% line coverage across 11 lib files.' The gate gives the same answer run from the repo root (default project resolution) and from inside billsplit/ with --project .

19 passed, 100% branch coverage across __init__, __main__ and checker. Covers both failure modes explicitly: uncovered lines are reported by name and line number, a lib file absent from the report is reported as 0% coverage, and a missing report exits 2 — the gate reports rather than failing silently.

verification.command: git check-ignore -v --no-index over every file in billsplit/
verification.evidence: Before the overrides, 32 of 146 files were swallowed (.gitignore:56 *.png x30, :62 *.ico, :153 *.manifest). After, zero files are blocked by the root .gitignore; the only remaining hits come from billsplit's own nested .gitignore files and are all generated artifacts.

Full commit-time hook set over all staged files: ruff, ruff-format, mypy, pylint, bandit, codespell, no-binaries, check-python-location, ai-evidence-contract, ai-multifile-contract and pytest-coverage. No --no-verify and no new per-file lint suppressions.

verification.command: pytest over every python_pkg/*/tests plus linux_configuration/tests, --cov python_pkg --cov-branch --cov-fail-under=100
verification.evidence: 1098 passed, 12 skipped, TOTAL 100% branch coverage; python_pkg/app_icons at 100% across all nine modules. Run against a probe venv because the system interpreter is missing eight declared dependencies — verified pre-existing by reproducing the same collection errors at HEAD in a detached worktree.

verification.command: resource.getrusage(RUSAGE_CHILDREN).ru_maxrss around the full pytest suite and around prettier
verification.evidence: Peak RSS 0.23 GiB for 1117 tests with branch coverage, and 0.10 GiB for prettier over a 14-file commit — against declared caps of 4G and 1G respectively. The new 2G and 512M ceilings are set from these numbers.

verification.command: systemd-run --user --scope -p MemoryMax=2G -p MemorySwapMax=0 -- pre-commit run --files $(git diff --cached --name-only)
verification.evidence: Every hook completes inside a hard 2G cgroup with swap disabled; no hook is OOM-killed. Previously the 4G pytest request could not be satisfied inside such a scope.

verification.command: python_pkg.app_icons render.safe_box_overflow for the receipt-split glyph
verification.evidence: (0, 0) — ink is 400x470, inside the 560px SAFE_BOX on both axes. Foreground and monochrome layers rendered over magenta to confirm the perforation holes are genuinely transparent.

risks: The ! overrides in .gitignore are path-prefixed to billsplit/. A future Flutter app added to this monorepo will hit the same silent-drop problem and needs its own block plus .binary-allowlist entries.

billsplit is the only Dart code in a repo whose pre-commit suite is Python/Bash-shaped: there is no dart format or flutter analyze hook, so Dart style is gated only by the GitHub workflow, not locally.

The coverage gate now sits two directories away from the app it guards. Renaming or moving billsplit/ silently breaks the parents[2] default path resolution in python_pkg/billsplit_coverage/checker.py; the test suite pins the behaviour but not the app's location.

billsplit's ThemeData still seeds from Colors.teal while the icon uses the family accent #B8862E, so the launcher icon does not match the app's first screen. Deliberately left alone as out of scope for a move.

The commit cannot be made until eight declared dependencies are installed into the system interpreter; the pytest-coverage hook runs the whole suite at commit time, and bypassing hooks is not an option.
rollback: git revert the move commit, then rm -rf billsplit/ — the app is self-contained under that one prefix apart from the .gitignore/.binary-allowlist/workflow/app_icons edits, which the revert restores.
The original tree remains at ~/Downloads/billsplit until the push is confirmed on origin, so a rollback before that point loses nothing.

After rollback, confirm python_pkg/app_icons tests still pass and that no other app's icon changed: the shared generator was extended with a new glyph, never edited in style.py, so the other seven apps' assets are untouched.
